metadata.title: Summarize Data for Network Session Essentials
metadata.description: This playbook summarizes data for Network Session Essentials and lands it into custom tables.
prerequisites: 1. Ensure all the details appearing in the deployment are correct.
postDeployment: 1. Authorize the 'Azure Monitor Logs' API connection. Log ingestion uses the playbook's managed identity.

properties.description: Data collection endpoint for Network Session Essentials summarized logs

inputs.body:
let nowTime = todatetime("@{variables('nowTime')}");
let lastRecievedTime = toscalar (
    union isfuzzy=true
        (
           NetworkCustomAnalytics_threat_CL 
            | summarize max(EventTime_t)
            | extend max_TimeGenerated = datetime_add('minute',10,bin(max_EventTime_t,10m))
        ),
        (
            print (nowTime)
            | extend max_TimeGenerated = datetime_add('day',-1,bin(print_0,10m)) 
            | project-away print_0
        )
        | summarize max(max_TimeGenerated)
    );
_Im_NetworkSession(starttime=lastRecievedTime,endtime=bin(nowTime,10m))
| where TimeGenerated < bin(nowTime,10m)
| extend Threat = coalesce(ThreatId,ThreatName)
| where isnotempty(Threat) or isnotempty(ThreatCategory)
| summarize count() by Threat, ThreatCategory, EventSeverity, DvcAction, bin(TimeGenerated,10m)
| extend EventTime = TimeGenerated

let nowTime = todatetime("@{variables('nowTime')}");
let lastRecievedTime = toscalar (
    union isfuzzy=true
        (
           NetworkCustomAnalytics_threat_ioc_CL 
            | summarize max(EventTime_t)
            | extend max_TimeGenerated = datetime_add('minute',10,bin(max_EventTime_t,10m))
        ),
        (
            print (nowTime)
            | extend max_TimeGenerated = datetime_add('day',-1,bin(print_0,10m)) 
            | project-away print_0
        )
        | summarize max(max_TimeGenerated)
    );
_Im_NetworkSession(starttime=lastRecievedTime,endtime=bin(nowTime,10m))
| where TimeGenerated < bin(nowTime,10m)
| extend Threat = coalesce(ThreatId,ThreatName)
| where isnotempty(Threat) or isnotempty(ThreatCategory)
| summarize count() by SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, SrcHostname, DstHostname, bin(TimeGenerated,10m)
| extend EventTime = TimeGenerated
